name: Point Light Voxel Injection
definition: Accumulates point light radiance into a 3D voxel grid by rendering scene geometry to a depth buffer, then dispatching a compute shader that reads voxel albedo/normal/radiance textures and the light's cube depth map to inject lighting data.
summary: Point Light Voxel Injection accumulates point light radiance into a voxel grid using cube map depth maps for occlusion-aware lighting, differing from standard geometry voxelization.
